nodes.title: Authentication & Identity Subsystem
nodes.content: Governs caller verification, pre-shared token authentication, cryptographic actor attribution, and identity role assignments across all substrate boundaries.

nodes.title: Storage & Persistence Engine Subsystem
nodes.content: Manages transactional persistence for requirement graph nodes, structural adjacency edges, vector embeddings, and embedded document source spans in PostgreSQL.

nodes.title: Protocol & Integration Gateway Subsystem
nodes.content: Exposes stateless MCP (Model Context Protocol) and REST HTTP interfaces, enforces protocol framing, rate limiting, and request context propagation.

nodes.title: Audit Ledger & State Lifecycle Subsystem
nodes.content: Records monotonic append-only state mutation events, reversible delta snapshots, atomic batch correlation, and draft revision lifecycle compaction.

nodes.title: Cross-Service Request & Trace Context Propagation
nodes.content: Every inbound gateway request, inter-module call, background worker task, and audit ledger entry MUST propagate x-trace-id and request_id. Uncorrelated operations are prohibited.

nodes.title: Non-Repudiable Actor Attribution & Token Fingerprinting
nodes.content: Every storage mutation, candidate proposal, and audit entry MUST record the verified actor_id and SHA-256 token_fingerprint derived from the authenticated token. Anonymous or unauthenticated system defaults are prohibited.

nodes.title: Canonical Typed Error Envelope Hierarchy
nodes.content: All internal errors MUST map to canonical typed error variants (AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED, STORE_CONFLICT, VALIDATION_FAILED, GATEWAY_TIMEOUT) with sanitized, non-leaking external representations. Raw database errors and stack traces MUST NOT be exposed.

nodes.title: Caller-Scoped Draft Isolation & Conditional Typing
nodes.content: Entities in DRAFT state MUST be isolated to author scope (created_by), permit UNCLASSIFIED node types per D-62, and NEVER enqueue embeddings or pollute active query indexes until promoted to ACTIVE.

nodes.title: Atomic Mutation Batch Correlation & Monotonic Sequencing
nodes.content: Every multi-entity mutation transaction MUST share a unified batch_id UUID and monotonic event_seq in the audit ledger, supporting point-in-time atomic reversion without partial state corruption.

nodes.title: Transaction Advisory Lock Acquisition Hierarchy
nodes.content: Any operation modifying graph topology or verifying DAG acyclicity MUST acquire the global advisory lock pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('tks_structural_mutation')) before acquiring any row-level locks to prevent deadlocks.

nodes.title: Multi-Byte UTF-8 Character Boundary Safe Span Slicing
nodes.content: All document source slicing operations MUST assert character boundary safety using is_char_boundary before slicing byte slices, preventing UTF-8 panic panics on multi-byte characters.

nodes.title: Zero Credential Leakage & Secret Redaction
nodes.content: Raw API tokens, cryptographic secrets, authorization headers, and sensitive attributes MUST NEVER be logged, included in error payloads, or persisted in unredacted audit delta snapshots.

nodes.title: Authorization Bearer Header Parsing & Pre-Validation
nodes.content: The system MUST parse HTTP Authorization Bearer headers and extract the raw token, returning AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED for malformed headers without leaking header contents.

nodes.title: SHA-256 Token Fingerprint Resolution
nodes.content: The system MUST compute a deterministic SHA-256 token fingerprint from the raw token and query the agent_identities table to resolve actor identity and active status.

nodes.title: Token Expiration & Clock Skew Validation
nodes.content: The auth subsystem MUST verify token expiration timestamps with a 60-second clock skew tolerance window, rejecting expired credentials with AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED.

nodes.title: Identity Role Resolution & Privilege Mapping
nodes.content: The system MUST map authenticated callers to an actor role (HUMAN, AGENT, ADMIN) and inject the actor claims into the request session context.

nodes.title: In-Memory Revocation Cache with Immediate Expiry
nodes.content: The system MUST maintain an in-memory LRU cache for valid token fingerprints, but MUST immediately invalidate cached identities upon administrative revocation.

nodes.title: Development Identity Seed Provisioning
nodes.content: Development environments MUST provision the well-known token tks_dev_token with role HUMAN and active status during initial database migration seed.

nodes.title: Per-Identity Request Rate Limiting
nodes.content: The gateway MUST enforce per-token rate limits using a sliding window token bucket, returning HTTP 429 when quota is exceeded without disconnecting persistent sessions.

nodes.title: Credential Sanitization & Redaction in Diagnostic Logs
nodes.content: All diagnostic log formatters MUST redact credentials, Bearer tokens, and signature hashes, replacing sensitive characters with [REDACTED].

nodes.title: Relational Node Storage with Embedded Document Spans
nodes.content: Graph nodes MUST be stored in the graph_nodes table with UUID primary keys, canonical node_key, embedded source span coordinates, and created_by author attribution.

nodes.title: Surrogate Edge Keys & Partial Active Indexes
nodes.content: Graph edges MUST use surrogate edge_id UUID keys with partial unique index on active edges and foreign keys with ON DELETE CASCADE to graph_nodes.

nodes.title: Structural Advisory Lock for DAG Mutations
nodes.content: All topology modifications modifying graph_edges MUST acquire the transaction-level advisory lock tks_structural_mutation prior to cycle verification.

nodes.title: Consolidated Node Embeddings Table & Status Machine
nodes.content: Vector embeddings MUST be stored in node_embeddings with explicit vector(384) type, status state machine (PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED), and retry tracking.

nodes.title: Recursive CTE Topological Adjacency Traversal
nodes.content: Context envelope queries MUST execute via recursive CTEs over active graph_edges with depth limit 3 and node limit 40, executing in under 50ms.

nodes.title: Caller-Scoped Draft Isolation Query Filters
nodes.content: Queries for graph nodes MUST filter out unapproved DRAFT entities unless explicitly requested with include_drafts and matching the caller's created_by identity.

nodes.title: UTF-8 Safe Zero-Copy Byte Span Slicing
nodes.content: Source text span extraction MUST assert is_char_boundary on start and end offsets before invoking str::from_utf8, returning SpanError on boundary violations.

nodes.title: Draft Conditional Check Constraint for UNCLASSIFIED Types
nodes.content: The database schema MUST enforce check constraint chk_node_type permitting UNCLASSIFIED strictly when lifecycle_state = 'DRAFT', rejecting it in ACTIVE.

nodes.title: MCP Protocol Dispatcher & Context Envelope Tool
nodes.content: The gateway MUST implement the get_context_envelope MCP tool, extracting target node, ancestors, and sibling constraints into a structured context envelope.

nodes.title: MCP Propose Node Mutation Protocol Handler
nodes.content: The gateway MUST expose propose_node_mutation accepting draft candidate nodes and edges, requiring actor authorization and transaction rollback protection.

nodes.title: Inbound Header Trace Extraction & Context Injection
nodes.content: The gateway MUST extract x-trace-id from incoming request headers or generate a UUID trace_id if absent, injecting it into RequestContext for downstream dispatch.

nodes.title: Bearer Authentication Tower Middleware
nodes.content: Axum HTTP gateway routes MUST pass through authentication middleware validating bearer tokens, calculating token fingerprints, and verifying caller status.

nodes.title: Standardized Error Envelope Serialization
nodes.content: Gateway responses MUST format errors using canonical JSON-RPC and REST envelopes containing code, message, and request_id, suppressing low-level details.

nodes.title: Requirements Query Sanitization & Prefix Matching
nodes.content: The query_requirements endpoint MUST sanitize search strings using plainto_tsquery and prefix matching, preventing hyphen negation query corruption.

nodes.title: Autonomous Elaboration Permission Gating
nodes.content: The gateway MUST allow verified agents to create execution tasks directly in ACTIVE state strictly under parent nodes with AUTONOMOUS_ELABORATION policy.

nodes.title: Gateway Mutation Audit Event Emission
nodes.content: Every mutation initiated through the gateway MUST synchronously log an audit event to the audit ledger before returning a 200 OK response.

nodes.title: Append-Only Audit Ledger with Monotonic Sequence
nodes.content: The audit ledger MUST record all state transitions using monotonic event_seq BIGINT identity keys and immutable event_id UUIDs.

nodes.title: Reversible State Delta Snapshots
nodes.content: Audit ledger rows MUST store delta JSONB capturing exact before/after field mutations, excluding secret fields and enabling point-in-time inversion.

nodes.title: Draft Revision Compaction on Staging Promotion
nodes.content: When draft entities are promoted to ACTIVE, the system MUST compact intermediate revisions into a single canonical audit event with draft_evolution_summary.

nodes.title: Atomic Mutation Batch Correlation Key
nodes.content: All audit events generated within the same database transaction MUST share an identical batch_id UUID for coordinated batch rollback.

nodes.title: Point-in-Time Entity State Reconstruction
nodes.content: The ledger subsystem MUST reconstruct historical entity states by sequentially applying deltas up to a specified event_seq or timestamp.

nodes.title: Unified Batch Reversion & Inverse Delta Execution
nodes.content: The revert_mutations routine MUST execute inverse deltas for a batch_id in reverse monotonic sequence within an atomic transaction.

nodes.title: Actor Attribution on Audit Ledger Insertion
nodes.content: Every audit entry MUST store verified actor_id, actor_type, and token_fingerprint, rejecting entries with anonymous or missing actor credentials.

nodes.title: Audit Log Retention & Historical Non-Destruction
nodes.content: Approved requirement mutations MUST NEVER be deleted or overwritten in-place, preserving complete audit lineage across the system lifetime.

nodes.title: Extract and Validate Authorization Bearer Header
nodes.content: Implement bearer token parser extracting Authorization header, redacting credentials from debug logs, and mapping malformed tokens to AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED.

nodes.title: Compute Token Fingerprint and Query Identity Store
nodes.content: Implement SHA-256 fingerprint generator from raw token, query agent_identities, and return verified actor_id without logging the raw token.

nodes.title: Validate Token Expiration with Clock Skew Window
nodes.content: Implement expiration timestamp checker allowing 60 seconds of clock skew, returning canonical AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED on stale tokens.

nodes.title: Construct Authenticated Actor Session Context
nodes.content: Assemble ActorContext containing actor_id, actor_type, token_fingerprint, and trace_id for downstream request propagation.

nodes.title: Invalidate Identity Token in LRU Cache on Revocation
nodes.content: Implement cache eviction hook purging revoked token fingerprints immediately from in-memory authentication cache.

nodes.title: Verify Dev Token Migration Seed in Database
nodes.content: Assert that tks_dev_token exists in agent_identities with active status and HUMAN role.

nodes.title: Track Per-Token Rate Limit Sliding Window
nodes.content: Maintain token bucket per token_fingerprint, rejecting excess requests with RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED while keeping connections open.

nodes.title: Redact Secrets from Diagnostic Trace Outputs
nodes.content: Implement string sanitizer replacing tokens, keys, and authorization headers with [REDACTED] in trace and error records.

nodes.title: Insert Graph Node with Source Spans and Author Attribution
nodes.content: Execute SQL insert for graph_nodes with embedded doc_path, doc_hash, byte_start, byte_end, and created_by author attribution.

nodes.title: Insert Graph Edge with Surrogate Key and Batch Correlation
nodes.content: Insert structural edge into graph_edges using surrogate edge_id UUID, lifecycle_state, and binding transaction batch_id.

nodes.title: Acquire Advisory Lock Prior to DAG Cycle Check
nodes.content: Call pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('tks_structural_mutation')) before verifying topological cycles and updating edges.

nodes.title: Enqueue Node Vector Embedding with Pending Status
nodes.content: Upsert node_embeddings entry with 384-dimensional vector slot, status PENDING, and exponential retry backoff parameters.

nodes.title: Execute Recursive CTE Context Envelope Query
nodes.content: Execute recursive CTE query traversing ancestor requirements and sibling constraints up to depth 3 with 40-node cutoff.

nodes.title: Filter Active Requirement Nodes Excluding Drafts
nodes.content: Construct SQL query filtering lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' and isolating drafts to matching created_by author credentials.

nodes.title: Validate UTF-8 Character Boundaries on Document Slicing
nodes.content: Assert is_char_boundary on start and end offsets before invoking str::from_utf8, returning typed SpanError on boundary invalidity.

nodes.title: Dispatch MCP get_context_envelope Request
nodes.content: Handle MCP context envelope tool invocation, propagate incoming trace_id, assemble envelope, and wrap errors in canonical format.

nodes.title: Dispatch MCP propose_node_mutation Request
nodes.content: Handle MCP proposal tool invocation, validate caller credentials, isolate candidate drafts, and return proposal ID.

nodes.title: Extract and Forward Inbound Trace ID in Gateway RequestContext
nodes.content: Extract x-trace-id header, default to generated UUID if absent, and inject into downstream RequestContext channel.

nodes.title: Verify Bearer Token in Axum Authentication Middleware
nodes.content: Authenticate incoming HTTP request, compute token_fingerprint, attach ActorContext, and reject invalid callers with 401 Unauthorized.

nodes.title: Serialize Canonical Error Envelope for Protocol Responses
nodes.content: Convert domain error into canonical JSON error envelope with standard error code, message, and trace_id, omitting raw SQL strings.

nodes.title: Sanitize Full-Text Query for query_requirements Endpoint
nodes.content: Sanitize query string removing hyphen negation triggers, escape tsquery wildcards, and execute PostgreSQL search.

nodes.title: Forward Structural Mutation Proposal to Transaction Runner
nodes.content: Forward proposed candidate nodes and edges to transactional engine under advisory lock with batch correlation.

nodes.title: Log Synchronous Audit Event for Gateway Mutations
nodes.content: Emit mutation audit event with verified actor_id, token_fingerprint, and trace_id upon successful gateway proposal execution.

nodes.title: Append Mutation Audit Event with Monotonic Sequencing
nodes.content: Insert audit ledger entry with monotonic event_seq, batch_id, entity_id, actor_id, token_fingerprint, and trace_id.

nodes.title: Build Sanitized Delta Snapshot for State Transitions
nodes.content: Generate delta JSONB capturing entity field changes while redacting sensitive credentials and token strings.

nodes.title: Compact Draft Revisions into Single Approved Event
nodes.content: Squash intermediate draft revision history into single APPROVED audit event with draft_evolution_summary JSONB.

nodes.title: Bind Transaction Batch ID Across Multi-Entity Mutations
nodes.content: Generate single batch_id UUID at transaction boundary and attach to all resulting audit events and edge rows.

nodes.title: Reconstruct Historical Entity State at Given Event Sequence
nodes.content: Query audit events by entity_id up to target event_seq and fold delta patches to produce point-in-time snapshot.

nodes.title: Revert Transaction Batch by Applying Inverse Deltas
nodes.content: Fetch all audit entries for batch_id, sort in reverse event_seq order, and apply inverse delta updates in atomic transaction.

nodes.title: Filter Audit Ledger by Authorized Actor Identity
nodes.content: Query audit ledger entries restricting results to caller's actor_id unless caller possesses ADMIN role privileges.
